newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices steady, volume down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices steady, volume down sharply.

text.p: Prices on Istanbul's gold exchange edged higher on world trends, but volume dived because of weak free market demand, dealers said on Thursday.
Gold closed at $386.95 an ounce and 1,084,500 lira per gram, up $0.40 and 500 lira from Wednesday.
Traded volume fell to 800 kilos from Wednesday's 1,552.
"Activity was quiet today because there was not much demand from the free market. Seasonal activity is about to come to an end," said a free market dealer.
Some 57 percent of total trade was in dollar terms as the lira sustained minor losses against the dollar.
The lira ended at 87,110 per dollar after Wednesday's 87,080.
Exchange members import gold and prefer to sell it in lira terms when the lira falls sharply against the dollar.
